about: What the dispatcher hears after a reboot (crates/core/src/boot.rs report): the shikigami that were mid-task, the user's sessions as last seen, and the after_reboot notes.

cases.name: nothing ran
cases.text:
After a reboot: seimei starts on a new boot of the machine.
No shikigami was mid-task.

cases.name: shikigami and the user's sessions, reported only
cases.text:
After a reboot: seimei starts on a new boot of the machine.
Shikigami that were mid-task: builder (running), asker (asking). Resumed with a continue, as after any restart: builder.
The user's sessions before the reboot: dev (busy, mid-turn) in /home/u/dev; notes (waiting: permission, with an open question) in /home/u/notes; asr (idle) in /home/u/asr. They are not resumed unless a note below says so; tell the user rather than act on them.

cases.name: notes from seimei and a shikigami, and a resume the user approved

session.name: dev
session.message: the reboot is done, go on

cases.text:
After a reboot: seimei starts on a new boot of the machine.
No shikigami was mid-task.
The user's sessions before the reboot: dev (busy, mid-turn) in /home/u/dev. They are not resumed unless a note below says so; tell the user rather than act on them.
After-reboot notes:
- from you: check the GPU clocks
- from shikigami builder: run my post-reboot checklist
seimei resumes these sessions of the user's in a terminal, as the user approved with the reboot: "dev" with "the reboot is done, go on". You hear how each went.
